snippet.title: Denshattack! Galaxies Autumn Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: Strap in for wild train-trick chaos in Denshattack! Take control of a gravity-defying train in a colourful Japanese dystopia. Grind rails, kickflip off platforms, rack up style points and fight rival gangs as you take on the sinister Miraidō corporation. Travel from Kyushu to Tokyo and beyond, conquer over 50 levels, face bizarre bosses and customise your ride to become the ultimate “Denshattacker”. Launching spring 2026 on PC, Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5.
